description.value: The Columbia Diner is a modern roadside-style diner in downtown Kamloops serving all-day breakfast alongside lunch and dinner menus built around smash burgers, fried chicken and waffles, and classic comfort food with a contemporary twist. With wall-to-wall windows overlooking the Kamloops mountain backdrop and a welcoming ethos toward locals and travellers alike, it makes a natural refuelling stop for cyclists passing through the BC Interior. The kitchen also offers takeout and delivery, and the restaurant hosts private events with flexible seating.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and corroborates OSM address (555 Columbia Street West, Kamloops), phone (236-425-5081), and website. The site confirms takeout/delivery service ('Order Take-Out Or Delivery' nav link) and describes a full-service diner with breakfast, lunch, and dinner menus. No mention of bike parking, water refills, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible full-service restaurant in downtown Kamloops — a clear inclusion as a food and drink stop for touring cyclists.
